transcript.line: You catch fragments by the fire — Lauren telling Tariq about you. The truth left this story two fires ago. What's left is better theater.
💧 Hans returns with water: +3 clean.
🚶 Tariq is back with Hans.
📖 Yukio is showing Ruth the classic red-and-white-spotted toadstool — where it grows, what's safe to eat.
The trial window closed. The audience makes a disappointed sound, like wind.

🌙 Night. The lingering The Redactor gorges at the treeline — 1,252 kcal gone from the stores. Endure it (they drift off within ~6 nights — the gorge is the price), or send a sortie: fighters, rations, real risk.
📺 CONTEST: The Wrong Map. The System hands you a map to buried alien rations. Exactly one thing on it is a lie. Find the lie, find the food.
📺 The System has taken You and Yukio. The village holds its breath.
📺 We watched the raid too. Fine doorway work. The show goes on regardless — the audience loves a tired hero.
📺 The grab comes at dawn. One more day. Sleep if you can.
Rain. Steady, cold, honest rain.
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.
Village meal: +1020 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
Tariq paces the hall, restless, then sits. Then paces.
Henry had the day of their life — 1223 kcal. The pantry can't take it all: 612 kcal goes in, 611 kcal is eaten at the fire.
Yukio and Hans lingered over the fire together.
Tariq and Hans lingered over the fire together.
🍽️ Ethan peeks into the pantry, then turns the foraging party back. "Plenty for days. Teaching the kids snares instead — they'll need to know."
🍽️ Yukio leaves the surplus by the fire for whoever's hungry. "The pantry can't take it. We can."
Yukio spent the afternoon sewing, and the Bark armor came apart in their hands. The bark strips are wasted.
🤒 Henry is back on their feet — the fever ran its course.

🌙 Raid — Thornfield came in the night from the northwest. They carried off ~1200 kcal from the pantry. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)
— DAY 63 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Overnight, White Oak Acorns (in shell); Hickory Nuts (in shell) went bad — beyond saving. You leave them for the flies.
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
Hans Brown reads the sky: rain tomorrow, freezing.
Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.

OH. Oh no. ...The gamblers are very quiet.
📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Felicia Romero is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
🕯️ Felicia Romero is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
What Felicia kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
"Felicia's gone." Ethan looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Felicia." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Lauren blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
📖 LEARNED: Scrounger (Level 1). Ruin looting finds +1 item.
📖 LEARNED: Steady Hands (Level 1). Fine work under pressure. Dressing game, stitching wounds, tying snares — no shake.
📖 LEARNED: Wound Care (Level 1). Clean it, close it, cover it. Pressure stops bleeding. Clean water is better than dirty hands.
⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)
"OH! OH! PRECISE MEND! The audience did NOT see that coming! Knowledge AMPLIFIES power! The gamblers are recalculating EVERYTHING!"
📖 LEARNED: Herbal Medicine (Level 1). Willow bark = aspirin. Yarrow stops bleeding. Plantain draws out infection. The pharmacy is outside.
📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
📖 LEARNED: Food Preservation (Level 1). Salt, smoke, dry. The big three. Salt draws water out; bacteria can't live without it.
🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
📖 The Codex turns a page: Felicia Romero, 63 days. The mantle passes to Lauren Liu.
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Lauren Liu, 56 — a hotel housekeeper. Their hands know different work now: Green Whisper, Berserker Rage.
The village's quarrel was with Felicia — and Felicia is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
You knew Felicia — not the office, the person. The fire keeps expecting them, and so do you. That's a heavier kind of stepping up. (+5 trauma)
At the grave, Hans, Anas, Yukio and 6 more speak for Lauren — "Felicia trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
The fire knew Lauren before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
